description: This file defines the DoctorsRepository class that encapsulates API calls related to doctors. It includes methods to fetch a list of doctors with optional specialty filtering and to fetch details of a specific doctor by ID. The class interacts with an ApiClient to perform network requests and processes responses to produce Doctor model instances.

classes.name: DoctorsRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing methods to interact with the backend API for doctor-related data. Supports fetching multiple doctors with optional filtering and fetching individual doctor details by ID.

methods.name: fetchDoctors
methods.description: Fetches a list of doctors from the backend, optionally filtered by specialty.

methods.name: fetchDoctorById
methods.description: Fetches a single doctor by their unique ID.

methods.name: _safeMap
methods.description: Safely casts and returns the response data as a Map; throws an error if the format is unexpected.

methods.name: _unwrap
methods.description: Extracts the nested data payload from various possible response envelope structures.
